metadata.question: Does the vegetation browning in Denmark increase in July 2018 compared to July 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS/061/MOD13Q1 (16-day NDVI composite, good for vegetation monitoring) - Date: July 2017 vs July 2018 - Location: Denmark (approximate center ~56°N, 10°E) 2. Masking strategy: - MOD13Q1 has quality flags (SummaryQA or DetailedQA) - Use SummaryQA to filter good quality pixels (0 = good data) - The question is about vegetation browning (decrease in NDVI), not clouds 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for July 2017 and July 2018 - Browning = decrease in NDVI (2018 < 2017) - "Increase in browning" means NDVI decreased more (more browning) - Valid Zero: NDVI can be legitimately low (bare soil, water) - C3: If NDVI is None, NaN, or out of range [-1, 1] - Answer A if NDVI_2018 < NDVI_2017 (more browning in 2018) - Answer B if NDVI_2018 >= NDVI_2017 (no increase in browning) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions denmark = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[8.0, 54.5], [15.5, 54.5], [15.5, 58.0], [8.0, 58.0], [8.0, 54.5]] ]) # 2. Data Acquisition col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \ .filterDate('2017-07-01', '2017-07-31') \ .filterBounds(denmark) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lte('SummaryQA', 1)) col_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \ .filterDate('2018-07-01', '2018-07-31') \ .filterBounds(denmark) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lte('SummaryQA', 1)) size_2017 = col_2017.size().getInfo() size_2018 = col_2018.size().getInfo() print(f"2017 Images: {size_2017}") print(f"2018 Images: {size_2018}") if size_2017 == 0 or size_2018 == 0: print("Missing data for one or both years.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI ndvi_2017 = col_2017.select('NDVI').mean() ndvi_2018 = col_2018.select('NDVI').mean() # Check pixel counts count_2017 = ndvi_2017.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=denmark, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NDVI').getInfo() count_2018 = ndvi_2018.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=denmark, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NDVI').getInfo() print(f"2017 Valid Pixels: {count_2017}") print(f"2018 Valid Pixels: {count_2018}") if count_2017 == 0 or count_2018 == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") else: # 4. Calculation val_2017 = ndvi_2017.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=denmark, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NDVI').getInfo() val_2018 = ndvi_2018.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=denmark, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NDVI').getInfo() # MODIS NDVI is scaled by 10000 ndvi_2017_scaled = val_2017 / 10000.0 if val_2017 is not None else None ndvi_2018_scaled = val_2018 / 10000.0 if val_2018 is not None else None print(f"NDVI 2017: {ndvi_2017_scaled:.4f}" if ndvi_2017_scaled is not None else "NDVI 2017: None") print(f"NDVI 2018: {ndvi_2018_scaled:.4f}" if ndvi_2018_scaled is not None else "NDVI 2018: None") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if ndvi_2017_scaled is None or ndvi_2018_scaled is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid NDVI values.") print("C3") elif ndvi_2017_scaled < -1 or ndvi_2017_scaled > 1 or ndvi_2018_scaled < -1 or ndvi_2018_scaled > 1: print("NDVI out of valid range [-1, 1].") print("C3") else: difference = ndvi_2018_scaled - ndvi_2017_scaled print(f"NDVI Change (2018-2017): {difference:.4f}") if ndvi_2018_scaled < ndvi_2017_scaled: print("Vegetation browning increased (NDVI decreased).") print("A") else: print("Vegetation browning did not increase (NDVI stable/increased).") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
denmark = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[8.0, 54.5], [15.5, 54.5], [15.5, 58.0], [8.0, 58.0], [8.0, 54.5]]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition
col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \
    .filterDate('2017-07-01', '2017-07-31') \
    .filterBounds(denmark) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lte('SummaryQA', 1))

col_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \
    .filterDate('2018-07-01', '2018-07-31') \
    .filterBounds(denmark) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lte('SummaryQA', 1))

size_2017 = col_2017.size().getInfo()
size_2018 = col_2018.size().getInfo()

print(f"2017 Images: {size_2017}")
print(f"2018 Images: {size_2018}")

if size_2017 == 0 or size_2018 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both years.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI
    ndvi_2017 = col_2017.select('NDVI').mean()
    ndvi_2018 = col_2018.select('NDVI').mean()
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count_2017 = ndvi_2017.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=denmark,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    count_2018 = ndvi_2018.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=denmark,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    print(f"2017 Valid Pixels: {count_2017}")
    print(f"2018 Valid Pixels: {count_2018}")
    
    if count_2017 == 0 or count_2018 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation
        val_2017 = ndvi_2017.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=denmark,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
        
        val_2018 = ndvi_2018.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=denmark,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
        
        # MODIS NDVI is scaled by 10000
        ndvi_2017_scaled = val_2017 / 10000.0 if val_2017 is not None else None
        ndvi_2018_scaled = val_2018 / 10000.0 if val_2018 is not None else None
        
        print(f"NDVI 2017: {ndvi_2017_scaled:.4f}" if ndvi_2017_scaled is not None else "NDVI 2017: None")
        print(f"NDVI 2018: {ndvi_2018_scaled:.4f}" if ndvi_2018_scaled is not None else "NDVI 2018: None")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if ndvi_2017_scaled is None or ndvi_2018_scaled is None:
            print("Calculation failed - invalid NDVI values.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif ndvi_2017_scaled < -1 or ndvi_2017_scaled > 1 or ndvi_2018_scaled < -1 or ndvi_2018_scaled > 1:
            print("NDVI out of valid range [-1, 1].")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            difference = ndvi_2018_scaled - ndvi_2017_scaled
            print(f"NDVI Change (2018-2017): {difference:.4f}")
            
            if ndvi_2018_scaled < ndvi_2017_scaled:
                print("Vegetation browning increased (NDVI decreased).")
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("Vegetation browning did not increase (NDVI stable/increased).")
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
